FQDN_05.initial: Please use a debug firmware to implement this case LAN PC----X0 DUT X1-----DNS Server I suggest to use a private DNS server and configure domains on your private server to test this case In my setup, I configured a domain on my own DNS server, domain: split.s20.com, I will use this domain to write the test steps.
FQDN_05.title: Verify FQDN got the reply code correctly from DNS when the option "Prefer IPv6 DNS Servers" is chosen
FQDN_05.result:
in step 4, case A, this situation will be treated as SOA type, check the interval between the first query and the next query message sent from DUT, if the minimum TTL < 12 mins, then the interval should be 12 mins, if the minimum TTL > 12 mins, the interval should be the minimum TTL value included in SOA response message, FW will keep sending queries to server in this interval until the max retry threshold time have been reached.
  case B, this situation will also be treated as SOA type, check the interval between the first query and the next query message sent from DUT, if the minimum TTL < 12 mins, then the interval should be 12 mins, if the minimum TTL > 12 mins, the interval should be the minimum TTL value included in SOA response message, FW will keep sending queries to server in this interval until the max retry threshold time have been reached.
  case C, in this situation, FW will send the second and third query to server in soon, and after three times, FW will send queries in an interval = 300s (5mins) until the max retry threshold have been reached.
